assets.derivedFrom: Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star Catalog, Gliese
assets.notes: Filtered to V<=6.5 (8920 stars). Fields: unit direction (equatorial J2000), Vmag, B-V, proper motion.

assets.attribution: JPL Solar System Dynamics — DE440 planetary ephemeris
assets.notes: P2. Chebyshev coefficients baked by tools/bake_ephemeris.py for 1950-2099, 13 segments. Sun/Mercury/Venus/Earth/Moon/Mars as true centres (sub-km vs Horizons); Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune as system barycentres (centre needs satellite kernels).

assets.attribution: JPL Horizons — Voyager 1/2, New Horizons, Parker Solar Probe, Juno, Cassini, JWST
assets.notes: P3.5. Baked by tools/bake_missions.mjs from Horizons VECTORS (barycentric ecliptic-J2000, [tdb_s,x,y,z] m). One polyline per craft, rendered with an epoch marker.

assets.attribution: IAU Minor Planet Center — asteroid orbital elements
assets.notes: P4. 100k brightest asteroids (a,e,i,Ω,ω,M0,epoch) baked by tools/bake_asteroids.mjs, sorted by H. Kepler solved on the GPU (TSL vertex shader), one draw call. ~97k main belt + 1.2k Jupiter Trojans.

assets.source: CelesTrak GP element sets (stations, gps-ops, geo; + full starlink group)
assets.attribution: CelesTrak (Dr. T.S. Kelso) — NORAD two-line elements
assets.notes: P3.5. Two SGP4 groups (satellite.js): a mixed set (~83) and the full Starlink constellation (~10.8k, throttled). Hover to name. A snapshot; TLEs go stale, so accuracy degrades far from the 2026-08 epoch.
